cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:21d680ae-1f0f-46.title: Senior Associate, Investor Operations
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:21d680ae-1f0f-46.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! POSITION PURPOSE: The Investor Operations team is seeking a Senior Associate to support the day-to-day execution of investor and fund operations processes and play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely, and well-coordinated operational support across the organization. This role partners closely with internal teams and external service providers to manage time-sensitive and confidential information related to investor servicing, fund administration, reporting, and transaction workflows. The Senior Associate serves as a central point of coordination for operational workflows, collaborating with Legal, Compliance, Fund Accounting, Tax, Marketing, IT, and Internal Audit to support effective execution and cross-functional alignment. This position is well-suited for a detail-oriented professional with 5+ years of relevant experience who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and brings strong judgment, accountability, and an internal client service mindset to their work.
responsibilities: Execution of complex investor operations processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and a best-in-class service experience.
Serve as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders and select external partners, providing proactive communication, issue resolution, and high-quality service delivery.
Review, approve, and oversee operational deliverables, including reconciliations, reporting outputs, and data validations, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
Independently investigate and resolve complex operational issues, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
Drive cross-functional coordination across Fund Accounting, Legal, Compliance, Tax, and Technology to ensure seamless execution of investor servicing workflows.
Drive recurring reporting cycles and operational processes, including planning, tracking, and execution across multiple workstreams.
Identify operational risks and control gaps; enhance processes, documentation, and controls to improve scalability and reduce risk.
Play a key role in system implementations, enhancements, and process automation efforts, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and business requirement input.
Develop, maintain, and enhance procedures and documentation to support a controlled, audit-ready environment.
Support audits, regulatory inquiries, and internal reviews by providing validated data and subject matter expertise.
Act as a resource and mentor to junior team members, providing guidance to support technical development.
Continuously evaluate workflows and service delivery, driving improvements that enhance efficiency and the overall stakeholder experience.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant experience in investor operations, fund operations, fund administration, transfer agency, or a similar financial services environment.
Experience supporting investor onboarding, capital activity, reporting, reconciliations, and operational controls in a regulated environment preferred.
FINRA licenses are a plus.
Communication Skills:
Demonstrates advanced written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and effectively engage internal stakeholders and external partners.
Builds strong, trusted relationships across cross-functional teams and serves as a reliable point of contact for operational matters.
Clearly communicates complex operational processes, issues, and recommendations to a variety of audiences.
Proactively manages stakeholder expectations through transparent communication, timely updates, and consistent follow-through.
Escalates issues strategically, providing context, recommendations, and ownership through resolution.
Maintains confidentiality and handles sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion.
Technical Skills:
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (particularly Excel), including working with large data sets, reconciliations, and reporting outputs.
Deep experience with CRM systems, data platforms, and workflow tools (e.g., Salesforce, Intralinks, Monday.com), with the ability to optimize usage.
Strong data management capabilities, including validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance of complex data sets.
Ability to identify inefficiencies in systems and processes and contribute to automation and optimization solutions.
Experience supporting or leading system implementations, enhancements, and testing (UAT) efforts.
Analytical Skills:
Strong understanding of investor operations processes, fund structures, and servicing requirements.
Ability to independently analyze complex data sets, identify discrepancies, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
Applies critical thinking to evaluate processes, improve accuracy, and enhance scalability of operations.
Demonstrates ownership and accountability for deliverables, ensuring high-quality outputs with minimal oversight.
Ability to connect operational data to broader business context and stakeholder impact.
Problem Solving & Organization:
Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for multiple complex workflows and deliverables.
Proactively identifies risks, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies, and drives solutions that improve processes and controls.
Effectively prioritizes competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high-quality standards.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage end-to-end processes and ensure proper documentation and audit readiness.
Takes initiative in driving continuous improvement and supporting team and organizational objectives.
Acts as a point of escalation and problem-solver for more junior team members.

compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Registered Nurse- PRN
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: Orthopaedic Institute Surgery Center, Metropolis, Illinois Orthopaedic Institute Surgery Center, located in Metropolis, Illinois, provides high-quality, patient-focused outpatient surgical care. The center is proudly partnered with Compass Surgical Partners, a national leader in ambulatory surgery center development and management. OISC Website https://orthoisc.com/. Through this partnership, the center combines the clinical excellence of a respected system with Compass’s innovative operational expertise. With three ORs and dedicated minor procedure rooms, the center offers comprehensive orthopaedic services—from sports medicine and joint replacements to spine and plastic surgery. The result is a culture that values safety, efficiency, and compassion—for both patients and staff. Hours- Per Diem during Monday-Friday. Role Summary: The Registered Nurse (RN) supports pre-op, OR, or PACU, and stepdown patient care at Orthopaedic Institute Surgery Center. This position is responsible for assessing patients, delivering individualized nursing care, monitoring recovery, and collaborating with the surgical team to ensure safe, efficient procedures and optimal outcomes. Hours: Full-time during Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:30 PM (hours may vary based on center needs). What You’ll do: - Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care in perioperative settings - Monitor patient status and respond to changes during recovery - Document accurately and communicate effectively with team members and patients - Maintain sterile environments and adhere to safety protocols - Support patient education and post-op instructions What You’ll bring: - Graduate of an accredited RN program - Current Illinois RN license (unencumbered) - Current BLS (ACLS required within 6 months) - Preferred: Member of the Association of Operating Room Nurses (AORN) - Strong clinical judgment, communication, and teamwork skills Physical & Work Environment Requirements - Frequent standing, walking, lifting, and manual dexterity - Exposure to surgical environments, equipment, and patient care areas Why Compass Surgical Partners? Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com. Compass Surgical Partners is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or hiring process, please contact us directly at info@compass-sp.com.

emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:a0fff2e5-6470-47.title: Principal Backend Software Engineer
emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:a0fff2e5-6470-47.description: The Role Infrastructure is our bread and butter at Alchemy. As an engineer focused on infrastructure and backend systems at Alchemy, you'll be working with one of the most sophisticated and high-throughput distributed systems in the blockchain world. You'll focus on architecting and building new systems as well as improving existing ones for a platform that supports millions of users globally. What You'll Do: - Define the vision for the backend infrastructure that supports our developer platform and APIs, and guide the team in executing against that vision - Design, build and maintain highly scalable and reliable infrastructure, APIs, and services - Contribute and lead system design discussions, stand-up meetings, and code reviews - Develop and own best practices for backend infrastructure with a focus on high throughput, high reliability, and low latency - Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack - Collaborate with other engineers, technical leaders, product managers, and designers What We're Looking For: - 10 + years of relevant industry experience - BS/BA degree in Computer Science or equivalent - Experience designing, building, scaling, and maintaining core backend software components (experience with API platforms a plus) - Ability to solve complex design, scaling, latency, or performance problems in high-throughput, low-latency systems in production - Production experience with Java, Golang, or C++ - Experience in Cloud Native environments, particularly in AWS - Experience with managed Kubernetes layers like AWS EKS a plus - Self-starter attitude and the ability to execute new ideas with autonomy - Know how to find the right balance between perfection and shipping quickly - Curiosity on the leading edge - plays with crypto, the latest in AI, and pushes to unpack black boxes BENEFITS & PERKS 🏥 Private Health Insurance 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🚅 Commuter Benefits 🌴 Flexible Time Off 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🧠 Learning & Development Stipend 🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events 🎧 Books & Audiobook subscription with Bookster https://landing.bookster.ro/

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:43f70475-c37.title: Events Specialist
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:43f70475-c37.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:310ab451-224b-.title: Senior Software Engineer New Markets
jobgether-jobgether:lever:310ab451-224b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer New Markets based in Canada. This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building and scaling mission-critical systems that support global financial markets. You will design and evolve highly available brokerage infrastructure serving millions of users and substantial transaction volumes. The role combines hands-on full-stack engineering with technical leadership, regional initiatives, and operational reliability ownership. You’ll work across backend services, internal platforms, APIs, vendor integrations, and systems supporting multiple markets and currencies. As part of a globally distributed engineering organization, you’ll collaborate across regions while operating with significant autonomy. You’ll also contribute to incident response, mentor engineers, and help shape technical practices and culture within the region. This is an ideal environment for an experienced engineer who enjoys complex systems, fintech challenges, and high-impact ownership. Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, mission-critical brokerage systems and services supporting global financial markets. Develop and enhance middle- and back-office platforms, including gRPC microservices, React-based internal interfaces, and third-party integrations. Work with core engineering teams to evolve frameworks and infrastructure supporting multiple languages, currencies, markets, and regional requirements. Lead technical initiatives within the region, including recruitment activities, cross-functional projects, engineering mentorship, and development of strong engineering practices. Act as the regional operational reliability and engineering lead, serving as incident commander during business hours and helping maintain proactive 24x7 system stability. Troubleshoot production incidents, customer-reported issues, and software defects while identifying and addressing underlying technical causes. Collaborate asynchronously and synchronously with global technical leads, adapting communication and coordination to a distributed environment. Navigate regulatory and market-specific requirements while designing scalable solutions that enable international expansion. Participate in on-call responsibilities and provide engineering support for critical incidents and time-sensitive technical initiatives. Requirements: Proven experience as a senior software engineer with strong computer science fundamentals and a track record of designing and architecting complex software systems. Strong proficiency in Go or a comparable backend programming language , with the ability to design robust, efficient, and scalable architectures. Experience with event-driven system design and distributed, high-availability applications. Strong problem-solving abilities, a proactive approach, and the confidence to make sound technical decisions in high-pressure situations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with global engineering teams, regulators, vendors, and business stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to lead incident response, troubleshoot complex production issues, and act with authority as an incident commander. Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully remote, globally distributed organization. Strategic mindset with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business strategies and outcomes. Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology environment is an advantage. Familiarity with domain-driven design, emerging technologies, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar platforms is beneficial. Experience in financial services, fintech, brokerage platforms, or online trading systems is highly desirable, particularly knowledge of order management, execution, market data, settlement

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c04dabb9-1416-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead based in Belgium. This role will lead the people side of complex, technology-enabled business transformations, with a strong focus on SAP and large-scale ERP implementations. You will shape change strategies that help organizations transition effectively to new processes, systems, and ways of working. The position combines stakeholder engagement, communications, organizational readiness, training, and adoption measurement. You will work across leadership teams, business stakeholders, project teams, and consulting partners to build alignment and momentum. A key focus will be helping manufacturing organizations navigate transformation while minimizing disruption and maximizing adoption. You will have significant ownership over OCM planning, execution, governance, and continuous monitoring throughout major initiatives. This is an opportunity for an experienced change leader to make a measurable impact across complex, enterprise-wide transformation programs. Develop and implement comprehensive Organizational Change Management strategies aligned with transformation objectives, project timelines, and business outcomes. Conduct stakeholder impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and change impact analyses to identify affected groups, risks, and adoption requirements. Establish and manage change networks, champion programs, and stakeholder engagement structures that support sustained adoption. Design and execute communication strategies, including executive toolkits, targeted messaging, leadership communications, and employee engagement materials. Facilitate leadership alignment sessions, stakeholder workshops, and engagement activities across different organizational levels. Define appropriate OCM governance frameworks, roles, processes, and decision-making structures for large-scale transformation programs. Create or contribute to comprehensive training strategies that prepare employees for new systems, processes, and operating models. Manage key change deliverables, including readiness assessments, management toolkits, communication materials, training plans, and adoption metrics. Monitor change-related risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans throughout implementation. Track adoption and organizational readiness metrics, using insights to adjust change strategies and improve transformation outcomes. Collaborate effectively with client teams, consulting partners, complementary service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure coordinated delivery. Requirements Proven experience leading Organizational Change Management initiatives for large-scale ERP or technology-enabled business transformation programs. Strong knowledge of SAP platforms, with SAP S/4HANA experience strongly preferred, and an understanding of the related business processes and transformation impacts. Demonstrated experience developing change communication strategies, stakeholder engagement plans, readiness assessments, and adoption measurement frameworks. Strong knowledge of organizational design, transition planning, and change impact analysis. Experience working within or supporting manufacturing organizations is required. Excellent facilitation, presentation, communication, and collaboration skills across executive, management, and operational levels. Ability to build effective working relationships across client organizations, consulting teams, technology teams, and external partners. Strong ability to manage multiple change workstreams, deliverables, risks, and stakeholders within complex transformation environments. Experience participating in at least five major business change initiatives involving SAP or comparable ERP platforms is preferred. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e32f1854-8691-.title: Head of Finance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e32f1854-8691-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance based in United States. This is a senior leadership opportunity to build and lead a modern Finance function within a fast-growing international payments environment. You will own management reporting, financial control, budgeting, settlements, cash-flow planning, and financial process optimization. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of financial models, reporting logic, reconciliations, and operational controls. You will partner closely with Data, Development, Treasury, and executive leadership to turn complex financial information into actionable business insights. A key focus will be replacing manual processes with reliable, automated reporting and scalable financial workflows. You will also oversee financial operations across multiple legal entities, currencies, products, merchants, and payment methods. This role is ideal for an experienced finance leader who thrives on ownership, transformation, and working in a data-driven, international environment. Own end-to-end management reporting, including P&L, Cash Flow Statement, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual analysis, and profitability reporting across products, merchants, payment methods, and legal entities. Build and maintain the budgeting and forecasting cycle, including operating budgets, payment calendars, cash-flow forecasts, gap analysis, scenario planning, and obligation tracking. Design and operate a robust financial control framework covering regular reconciliations, discrepancy classification, resolution SLAs, approval workflows, audit trails, and manual adjustment controls. Manage merchant settlements, including settlement calculations, provider fees, minimum fees, surcharges, refunds, chargebacks, FX conversions, and balance transfers. Oversee finance across multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany transactions, including consolidated reporting and preparation of information for statutory accounting and external audits. Serve as the business owner for financial automation by defining financial logic, KPIs, formulas, data sources, requirements, and acceptance criteria for dashboards and reports.
